correctness.rationale: For W=(0^a1^b)^t (a,b≥1,t≥2), the four-factor hit conditions 0^a,1^b,01,10 are necessary. Any long factor (length≥a+b) has overlapping period-shifted occurrences covering every internal 10 transition; any shorter unary factor embeds around a marked position of its maximal run; mixed shorter factors containing 10 embed at the selected internal 10 transition; the remaining short mixed 0^u1^v embed at a marked 01. Hence the certificate is sufficient for arbitrary position sets. Two symbol markers are necessary; distinct boundary configurations give the claimed 2t(t−1), (t−1)(bt+1), (t−1)(at+1) pair counts, including a=b=1. Direct fresh literal-factor enumeration verified the full four-factor equivalence for ALL 28,880 candidate subsets over 18 small parameter triples, and pair counts independently. This is finite corroboration, not the all-parameter proof.
